stem.text: The infra-red spectra of three organic compounds are shown.

stem.label: spectrum 1
stem.alt: IR spectrum 1 (transmittance against wavenumber): strong absorption near 1720 cm-1 and no broad O-H band.

stem.label: spectrum 2
stem.alt: IR spectrum 2 (transmittance against wavenumber): broad absorption from about 3500 to 2500 cm-1 and a strong absorption near 1710 cm-1.

stem.label: spectrum 3
stem.alt: IR spectrum 3 (transmittance against wavenumber): broad strong absorption near 3350 cm-1, no strong band near 1700 cm-1, and strong absorptions between 1000 and 1250 cm-1.

stem.text: What could the three compounds be?
